entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Kestrel HTTP/3: a peer reset of a not-yet-identified bidirectional stream faults the whole connection #70396
  • Kestrel WebTransport never releases finished streams: session stalls after 100 streams and leaks ~3.7 KB per stream #70395
  • Blazor Hybrid Windows publish still copies precompressed .gz and .br assets from referenced RCLs into publish/wwwroot #70394
  • Renderer.Dispose does not clear _eventBindings or cascading parameter subscriptions, retaining disposed components #70393
  • WebViewJSRuntime / JSRuntime never cancels or faults in-flight _pendingTasks when disconnected #70392
  • [Blazor] Server: an enhanced navigation made before the circuit's renderer attaches never reaches it; NavigationManager.Uri stays on the start address #70391
  • [Blazor] Interactive server component added while the circuit's first UpdateRootComponents is still pending is never rendered ("Cannot update existing state: previous state has not been cleared") #70390

Closed

  • [Validation] Building and publishing a Blazor Hybrid app with its own JavaScript modules #68814
